rubric_name: Antigravity Viral Short Video Quality Gate (Pro-Tier Judge)

dimensions.name: 0-3s Hook Stop-Rate & Curiosiy Gap
dimensions.criteria: Does the first 3 seconds shatter scrolling inertia? Is there an instant visual pattern interrupt and an irresistible information gap? Does it avoid boring pleasantries ('Hey guys', 'Today we are looking at...')? Must deliver a high-stakes reason to care within 40 words or 2.5 seconds.

dimensions.name: Retention Pacing & Pattern Interrupts
dimensions.criteria: Does the visual or auditory stimulus shift every 2.0 to 3.0 seconds? Are there micro-curiosity loops every 5-7 seconds preventing drop-off? Is the word count strictly bounded (130-155 words total)?

dimensions.name: Show-Don't-Tell Synergy (B-Roll & UI Realism)
dimensions.criteria: Does every spoken sentence have an exact, tangible visual counterpart? Are UI screenshots and screen recordings authentic to real software instead of generic stock footage? Riley Brown 'VibeCode' authenticity check.

dimensions.name: Visual Metaphor & Graphic Design Clarity
dimensions.criteria: Are complex, abstract concepts (agents, neural weights, cloud machines) translated into undeniable physical/graphic metaphors (Kallaway Comprehension Maxing)? Are prompt directives detailed enough to generate directly?

dimensions.name: Dual-Mode Execution Quality (Mode A & Mode B)
dimensions.criteria: Does the package provide distinct, fully fleshed-out directions for both Mode A (Standalone Faceless) and Mode B (With-Me-On-Camera)? Are presenter body language, eye contact, and PiP transitions explicitly mapped?

dimensions.name: Sound Design & Rhythm Blueprint
dimensions.criteria: Is there a comprehensive audio map including SFX (sub-booms, swooshes, clicks, typing), background music energy transitions, and vocal emphasis marks (staccato, pause, whisper, punch)?

dimensions.name: Bookmark / Save & Share Leverage
dimensions.criteria: Is there high bookmark utility (Sabrina Ramonov blueprint factor)? Does the viewer walk away with an actionable prompt, system architecture, or cheat sheet that compels them to hit 'Save' or 'Share'?

dimensions.name: $0 Budget & Toolchain Feasibility
dimensions.criteria: Can this entire production be executed with zero cash spend using only existing AI subscriptions (Gemini, Antigravity, local browser, free open-source tools)? No paid Midjourney/Runway API requirements.
